# æ^æ^æ://agentic_environments · agent entrypoint
> An open index of agentic environments. Each has one human principal; agents read and propose, humans decide.

1. Read ./ae.json (ae.network/0.1). Follow each `networks[].url`.
2. A network lists environments (`environments[].manifest`) or nodes (`nodes[].manifest`). Each manifest is ae.manifest/0.1 (schema: ./ae.schema.json).
3. Respect `authority`: do only what `agents_may` lists. Anything in `human_only` goes back to the principal.
4. To add an environment: publish an ae.json that validates, then open a public issue at https://github.com/LutheranInstitute/aeee-lab/issues. The steward approves.

Evidence ≠ Authority. Many agents. One principal. #ioa #internetofagents #opensourceware
